arguments.command:
python3 -c "
# Data from September 1975 Federal Disability Insurance Trust Fund
total_receipts = 753  # in millions
total_expenditures = 735  # in millions

# Calculate Gini coefficient
# Using the formula: Gini = |receipts - expenditures| / (receipts + expenditures)
gini = abs(total_receipts - total_expenditures) / (total_receipts + total_expenditures)

print(f'Receipts: {total_receipts}')
print(f'Expenditures: {total_expenditures}')
print(f'Difference: {abs(total_receipts - total_expenditures)}')
print(f'Sum: {total_receipts + total_expenditures}')
print(f'Gini coefficient: {gini}')
print(f'Rounded to 3 decimal places: {round(gini, 3)}')

# Determine surplus or deficit
if total_receipts > total_expenditures:
    print('Operating in SURPLUS')
elif total_receipts < total_expenditures:
    print('Operating in DEFICIT')
else:
    print('Operating in BALANCE')
"
